TreVeyon Henderson.note: Ruled out for the season opener after missing all game-week practices with the ankle injury suffered Aug. 24. Week 2 remains uncertain.

Zach Charbonnet.note: Unavailable for at least the first four games while rehabbing a torn ACL. Seattle has been encouraged by his rehab, but there is no firm return date.

Tory Horton.note: Was limited throughout game week and inactive for Seattle's opener. Hamstring issue follows an injury-interrupted 2025 season.

George Kittle.note: Successfully returned from the January Achilles tear in San Francisco's Week 1 win over the Rams, catching two of five targets for 12 yards with no reported in-game setback. His usage remained below a normal Kittle workload, but completing the game materially improves near-term availability confidence. Participation is expected to increase progressively in coming weeks.
George Kittle.expectedReturn: Active; workload expected to ramp up

Rome Odunze.note: Limited on the first Week 1 report with a new calf injury after sitting out earlier work. Day-to-day and not yet fully cleared.

Jonathon Brooks.note: Brooks says he is 100 percent healthy and expects to play Week 1. He remained limited Thursday, but the current groin soreness is not in his surgically repaired knee. The injury-only workload penalty has been reduced; any Chuba Hubbard/Brooks backfield split should be handled as role/value context rather than an injury penalty.

Zay Flowers.note: Upgraded from limited Wednesday to a full participant Thursday while working back from the hamstring issue. Flowers has said he expects to play Sunday, and the full practice materially lowers the short-term availability concern.

Michael Penix Jr..note: Practiced fully, but Atlanta has confirmed Penix will be inactive for Week 1 while the team continues a cautious return-to-game ramp following his 2025 ACL tear. The full practice is encouraging, but game availability has not yet been restored.
Michael Penix Jr..expectedReturn: Week 2 or later; no firm game-return date

Tua Tagovailoa.note: Atlanta has ruled Tagovailoa out for the Week 1 opener after the oblique injury suffered during Thursday practice. He was absent from the media-access portion of Friday practice, and Cooper Rush will start against Pittsburgh. No firm return timetable beyond Week 1 has been announced, so Week 2 remains possible but uncertain.

Alvin Kamara.status: Expected Week 1 - MCL; limited workload likely
Alvin Kamara.note: Returned to limited practice while recovering from the MCL sprain, and NewOrleans.Football's Nick Underhill now expects Kamara to play Week 1 barring a setback. A reduced early workload remains likely, with passing-down work expected to be his primary role initially.

Isiah Pacheco.note: On injured reserve and must miss at least four games. Detroit has not provided a firm return timetable.

Tank Dell.note: On injured reserve with a knee issue and unavailable until at least Week 5.

James Conner.note: On injured reserve with a foot injury and unavailable for the opening portion of the season.

Jeremiyah Love.note: Arizona is optimistic he can play Week 1, but he is returning from a high-ankle sprain and is listed behind Tyler Allgeier on the unofficial depth chart. Initial workload could be reduced.

Josh Jacobs.note: Currently unavailable to play because of an off-field league status with no established football return date. This adjustment reflects availability uncertainty, not injury performance risk.

Brock Bowers.note: Underwent a meniscus trim and is expected to miss one to two games. No major long-term efficiency penalty is assumed yet.

Malik Nabers.status: Full practice - Week 1 decision pending (ACL/meniscus return)
Malik Nabers.note: Nabers has practiced fully throughout game week and says he feels good, but on Thursday he stopped short of committing to playing Sunday and said the final decision is his. He also acknowledged a possible pitch count if active. The full practices are encouraging, but Week 1 availability and workload are less certain than previously assumed.
Malik Nabers.expectedReturn: Week 1 game-time decision; limited role possible

Xavier Legette.note: Not listed on Carolina's Week 1 injury report after recovering from the August ankle injury and walking-boot period. He is medically cleared for the opener; any playing-time limitation is role-based rather than injury-based.

Jakobi Meyers.note: Practicing in a non-contact jersey with a thumb injury. Current concern is primarily Week 1 workload rather than long-term availability.

Marvin Mims Jr..note: Denver listed Mims with a foot issue on Thursday's Week 1 injury report, but he was a full participant. He is currently expected to be available for Monday night, so only a minimal temporary workload modifier remains pending the final game-status report.

Patrick Mahomes.note: Fully cleared following ACL/LCL rehabilitation and expected to start Week 1. Mahomes has reported no planned playing restrictions; only a minimal residual long-term post-reconstruction risk modifier remains until regular-season game action is confirmed.

A.J. Brown.note: New England has now placed Brown on injured reserve after the high-ankle sprain suffered in the opener. He must miss at least the next four games, and current reporting places the recovery window at roughly four to six weeks. The multipliers are unchanged because the prior adjustment had already priced in an expected absence of at least four weeks; the IR move increases certainty around that timeline rather than materially worsening the projected recovery.
A.J. Brown.expectedReturn: Earliest Week 6; approximately 4-6 week recovery window

Sam Darnold.status: OUT Week 2 - hip strain; no structural damage
Sam Darnold.note: Follow-up testing showed no structural damage after the right hip injury suffered in Seattle's opener. The injury is muscular rather than a fracture or major structural issue. Darnold is expected to miss Week 2, with a possible return in Week 3 if his recovery progresses normally.

Alec Pierce.note: Practiced on a limited basis on Indianapolis' first Week 1 injury report while returning from heel surgery. He is trending toward availability, so the adjustment is limited primarily to possible early workload restriction.

Jacory Croskey-Merritt.note: Limited in both Wednesday and Thursday practices with the groin injury that first surfaced in late August. He has been back practicing since Sept. 1 and is still expected to have a chance to play Week 1, but consecutive limited sessions create enough short-term availability and workload uncertainty to warrant a modest injury adjustment pending Friday's final status.

De'Zhaun Stribling.status: OUT Week 1 - left ankle; severity pending
De'Zhaun Stribling.note: Suffered a non-contact left-ankle injury in the second quarter of San Francisco's opener after briefly returning from an earlier ankle issue. He could not bear full weight and was carted off. Kyle Shanahan said the Achilles is intact, but the magnitude of the ankle injury remains unknown and further evaluation is pending.
